verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's docs describe OpenAI-compatible endpoints and parameters such as service_tier, fail_fast and reasoning_effort. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference, a try-it console or runnable in-browser examples. Probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec returned 404 at every candidate path, so there is no evidence of a spec-driven interactive reference either. Static parameter documentation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
